nodes.name: LDH@SiO2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: 200 μL of IGEPAL CO-520 was dispersed in 6.6 mL of cyclohexane... before methanol was added to the suspension to precipitate the solid exfoliated SiO₂-encapsulated LDH layers, labeled as LDH@SiO₂. The produced LDH@SiO₂ nanosheets were collected by centrifugation and washed with ethanol and deionized (DI) water.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of LDH@SiO₂ (with a Single-Layered Silica Shell)... The produced LDH@SiO₂ nanosheets were collected by centrifugation and washed with ethanol and deionized (DI) water.

nodes.name: h-SiO2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: LDH@SiO₂ nanosheets were dispersed in 3M HCl solution with a concentration of LDH@SiO₂ = 1 mg mL⁻¹ and stirred continuously for 3 h at room temperature. The resultant h-SiO₂ nanosheets were collected by centrifugation and then repeatedly washed with DI water.
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of h-SiO₂ and h-(dl)SiO₂ Nanosheets. In general, h-SiO₂ nanosheets of the 2D hollow nanospace were synthesized by selectively removing the LDH layer present in LDH@SiO₂.

nodes.name: LDH@SiO2(NH2)2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: The synthetic process followed was the same as that for LDH@SiO₂, but instead of forming a TEOS-derived silica shell, individual single-layered LDH (SL-LDH) nanosheets were conformally coated with a aminosilane-modified SiO₂ shell from the hydrolysis condensation of the TEOS mixture with 2 vol% N-[3-(trimethoxysilyl)-propyl]ethylenediamine (TMSD) (0.8 μL TMSD in 40 μL silane mixture).
nodes.source_text: Synthesis of LDH@SiO₂(NH₂)x (Aminosilane-Modified Silica Shells)... The volumetric percentage of TMSD (P_NH2 = x) in the silane mixture (40 μL) was varied to... 2% by using 0.8 μL of TMSD...

nodes.name: LDH@(dl)SiO2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: The synthetic process followed was the same as that for LDH@SiO₂(NH₂)₂ but after 24 h of silica-shell formation from the silane mixture, pure TEOS (10 μL) was added again into the suspension and then kept for an additional 24 h of stirring at room temperature for further TEOS-derived pure silica-shell growth around the initially formed LDH@SiO₂(NH₂)x in the reaction. Thus, a double-layered- (dl) silica shell is generated in the core-shell product, denoted as LDH@(dl)SiO₂ nanosheets.

nodes.name: h-(dl)SiO2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: h-SiO₂(NH₂)x and h-(dl)SiO₂ nanosheets were also obtained by selective removal of the LDH layer from LDH@SiO₂(NH₂)x and LDH@(dl)SiO₂, respectively.
nodes.source_text: Similarly, h-SiO₂(NH₂)x and h-(dl)SiO₂ nanosheets were also obtained by selective removal of the LDH layer from LDH@SiO₂(NH₂)x and LDH@(dl)SiO₂, respectively.

nodes.name: 2D-Pt@(dl)SiO2 synthesis
nodes.procedure: An aqueous suspension of the presynthesized h-(dl)SiO₂ nanoreactor (0.5 mL, 2 mg mL⁻¹) was mixed with Na₂PtCl₄ (0.5 mL, 10.44 mM) and stirred for 30 min at room temperature to allow Pt²⁺ coordination. Next, aqueous ascorbic acid (AA) solution (0.5 mL, 10.44 mM) was added, followed by heating to 70°C and stirring for 10 min. The product 2D-Pt@(dl)SiO₂ was collected by centrifugation and washed with DI water.

unit_operations.name: Pt precursor coordination
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: h-(dl)SiO₂ (0.5 mL, 2 mg mL⁻¹) mixed with Na₂PtCl₄ (0.5 mL, 10.44 mM) and stirred for 30 min at room temperature.

unit_operations.name: Chemical reduction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: AA solution (0.5 mL, 10.44 mM) added, then stirred for 10 min at 70°C in preheated oil bath.

nodes.source_text: Synthesis of 2D-Pt@(dl)SiO₂ Nanosheets. In order to perform Pt growth within the nanospace...

nodes.name: 2D-PtND isolation
nodes.procedure: To isolate the 2D Pt product from the silica shell, 2D-Pt@(dl)SiO₂ was mixed with HF (48-51%), and the resultant dispersion with 1 mg mL⁻¹ concentration of 2D-Pt@(dl)SiO₂ was shaken for 24 h at room temperature. Next, the silica-etched Pt suspension, labeled as 2D-PtND, was isolated by centrifugation and washed thoroughly with DI water.
nodes.source_text: To isolate the 2D Pt product from the silica shell, 2D-Pt@(dl)SiO₂ was mixed with HF (48-51%)...

nodes.name: 2D-PtND/LDH hybrid assembly
nodes.procedure: 12.5 mL of aqueous dispersion of 2D-PtND (0.4 mg mL⁻¹) was added dropwise into a formamide suspension of the exfoliated NiFe-LDH (25.0 mL, 0.4 mg mL⁻¹) under constant stirring and kept for 24 h at room temperature. The resultant flocculate was recovered after centrifugation at 6000 rpm and repeatedly washed with DI water and ethanol.

nodes.description: HER LSV performance in 1.0 M KOH (95% iR-corrected)
nodes.source_text: 2D-PtND/LDH had the highest HER activity among the tested materials only needing overpotentials of 25 and 87 mV to reach current densities of 10 and 100 mA cm⁻²... Tafel slope of only 32.2 mV dec⁻¹... well maintained even at a high current density, as reflected in the Tafel slope value of 38.0 mV dec⁻¹... 2-fold increase in its exchange current density (1.65 mA cm⁻²)... smallest charge transfer resistance (R_ct = 5.9 Ω)... Pt mass activity of 2.87 mA μg_Pt⁻¹ (at an overpotential of 70 mV), which is an 11.21-fold improvement
In contrast, the 2D-PtNDs and 20% Pt/C exhibited Tafel slopes as high as 64.4 and 164.2 mV dec⁻¹, respectively

nodes.description: Cyclic stability test after 10000 CV cycles
nodes.source_text: the polarization curve of 2D-PtND/LDH remained almost unchanged with only 4 and 18 mV increases for η₁₀ and η₁₀₀, respectively, after 10 000 CV cycles.
Additionally, it also delivered stable performance in the 24 h CP test
The developed catalyst-loaded electrode recorded a highly esteemed 90% activity retention in a 100 h electrochemical run while achieving a 10 mA cm⁻² current density

nodes.characterization_summary: 2D-PtNDs show uniform sheet-like morphology with lateral dimension of 240±10 nm and dendritic configuration of interconnected nanobranches.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The AFM-measured average thickness of the 2D-PtNDs was ∼1.5 nm corresponding to 3−4 Pt atom layers... TEM investigation confirmed the flat lamellar structure, which was composed of dendritically interconnected nanocrystalline branches (d=∼3 nm).

nodes.characterization_summary: AFM confirms 2D-PtNDs have average thickness of ∼1.5 nm corresponding to 3-4 Pt atom layers.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The AFM-measured average thickness of the 2D-PtNDs was ∼1.5 nm corresponding to 3−4 Pt atom layers.

nodes.characterization_summary: HRTEM reveals fcc Pt phase with exposed {110} facet at basal planes, lattice spacing of 0.23 nm for {111} planes, and hexagonal disc-shaped Pt grains.
nodes.evidence_snippet: TEM investigation confirmed the flat lamellar structure, which was composed of dendritically interconnected nanocrystalline branches... of the face centered cubic (fcc) Pt phase.

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM shows homogeneous image contrast indicating atomically flat 2D surface morphology, coplanar alignment of nanobranches, and uniaxial orientation of {110} planes parallel to surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: high-resolution HAADF-STEM results demonstrated the homogeneous image contrast over the entire area, indicative of the atomically flat uniform 2D surface morphology... STEM-FFT analyses also confirm the uniaxial orientation of the {110} planes parallel to the 2D-PtND surface.

nodes.characterization_summary: SAED ring pattern corresponds to prevailing {111} crystal planes of fcc Pt.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The highly intense selected area electron diffraction (SAED) ring pattern (inset) corresponded to the prevailing {111} crystal planes.

nodes.characterization_summary: EDS elemental maps confirm Pt distribution and stacking of 2D-PtND monolayer on NiFe-LDH in 2D-PtND/LDH hybrid.
nodes.evidence_snippet: From the HAADF-STEM and EDS elemental mapping investigations, the monolayered 2D-PtND nanosheet... was noticed to stack on NiFe-LDH.

nodes.characterization_summary: XPS Ni 2p and Pt 4f spectra of 2D-PtND/LDH show Pt(0) binding energy shift from 71.17 eV to 70.81 eV and Ni(II/III) from 855.66/857.06 eV to 855.88/857.69 eV indicating electron density transfer from NiFe-LDH to 2D-PtND.
nodes.evidence_snippet: the countershift of the binding energies of Pt(0) and Ni(II and III) [71.17 eV → 70.81 eV for Pt(0) and 855.66/857.06 → 855.88/857.69 eV for Ni(II/III)] suggested an electron density transfer from NiFe-LDH to 2D-PtNDs.

nodes.characterization_summary: EELS elemental map confirms amine-rich inner-SiO2 layer in h-(dl)SiO2 nanoreactor used for 2D-PtND synthesis.
nodes.evidence_snippet: EELS elemental map confirming the amine-rich inner-SiO2 layer and pure SiO2-based outer shell.
